main_text.p: ea, quæ de ijs rebus Dei verbo traduntur. In quo certè quidem cernitur admiranda planè Dei Providentia, & cura de genere humano, & de hac sua veritate inter homines conferuanda, qui tot etiam in illis Ethnicorum monumentis nostræ, id est, sue, sacræ, verèque Historiæ, quanuis vetustissimæ, vestigia, testimoniáq; extare etiamnum hodie voluerit. Sic enim omnes eas primas Orbis res gestas & Antiquitates adumbrarunt Ethnici, ut vnus illis duntaxat color, id est propria eorum (quos Moses commemorat) nomina desint, ut Moisasse videantur, sic earum memoriam retinuerunt, licèt longissimo illo temporis interuallo iam quasi detrita, & velut fumo obscuratam, ut magna lux veritatis facilè in eorum scriptis splendescat, imò perspicua eniteat. Quædam habent illi quidem, fateor, propter annos interpolata, & velut carie quadam exesa & obsoleta: sed tamen quæ nullo negotio possint ex Mo-fis

page.notes: Text is set in roman with long s rendered as s; italic words rendered in italics where recognised. The first line of the page is the running head "EPISTOLA" with the letter spacing of the printed head. Some words are blurred by the scan ("Moisasse", "vetustissimæ") and "Moisasse" may be a printing error for "Moisi"; not certain. Final "fis" is a catchword-like fragment at the lower right and is kept as a note.
